messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: initial values in RStan/PyStan output?
parts:
The initial value is being saved in the Stan 2.0 command
line program.

I'd like to have the same behavior in RStan, PyStan,
etc. (Daniel --- this can go in the xxxStan spec.)

Sorry if it's already there --- I didn't know what to write
back to the person on the user's list about the new RStan.

I also added a feature request for doc in the Wiki on
how to build and install RStan from source. (Sorry if it's
there somewhere already --- I couldn't find it.)

- Bob

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] initial values in RStan/PyStan output?
parts:
Suppose we run the eight school example at https://code.google.com/p/stan/wiki/RStanGettingStarted#Example_1:_Eight_Schools, we can use get_inits as follows. 

It is not in the csv files for now.

> ii

[[1]]$tau
[1] 0.6452438

[8] -0.4932346

[[1]]$theta
[1]  1.49415540  0.84424232 -0.07437499  1.52637900 -0.07204463  1.37486092
[7]  1.15921362  0.36555088


[[2]]
[[2]]$mu
[1] -0.9556651

[[2]]$tau
[1] 4.332435

[[2]]$eta

[8] -0.1321233

[[2]]$theta
[1]  5.537699  5.821811 -9.173065 -2.258978 -2.469717  1.494291 -3.045082
[8] -1.528081


[[3]]
[[3]]$mu
[1] -1.023053

[[3]]$tau
[1] 0.1470396

[[3]]$eta
[1]  0.6825585 -1.3558435 -1.7691651 -0.7966862 -0.5692770  0.1701447 -0.9438256
[8]  1.5039454

[[3]]$theta
[1] -0.9226900 -1.2224157 -1.2831904 -1.1401975 -1.1067594 -0.9980351 -1.1618328
[8] -0.8019136


[[4]]

[1] 0.7117374

[[4]]$tau
[1] 0.8896294

[[4]]$eta
[1] -0.05865353  0.57099054 -0.13552422  0.44198954 -1.89727981  0.03972086

[[4]]$theta

Thanks --- you already mentioned the function was there. My
problem was that I didn't know about it and didn't see it scanning
the index. Of course, I saw it in the doc as soon as you pointed me to it.

(Speaking of which, the reason I didn't find the building from
source is that you had an index that didn't include it. I updated
and organized the index with some descriptions. Thanks again for
putting it there in the first place.)

I do NOT think this should go in the getting started docs.

- Bob
